'''May 2000 Mount Prospect tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Games Plus, Mt. Prospect, Illinois on 20 May 2000. [[Steve Kuperman]] won it. It is known from Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d780">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-mt-prospect-illinois-5-20-2000d780/ mt-prospect-illinois-5-20-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-mt-prospect-illinois-5-20-2000d780/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Games Plus, Mt. Prospect, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Kuperman]]
